in_arabic.name: يونس
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من كلمة يونس، دلالة على الصبر والتوكل
in_arabic.long_meaning: يونس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: الحوت، الصبر، التوكل على الله. يأتي من الآية القرآنية 'فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ عَلِيٌ مُبِينٌ وَإِنِّي أَخَذَ رَبِّي بِعَهْدٍ لِي إِنَّهُ لَیْسَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَجَلُهُ قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةٌ لَكُمْ وَرِزْقٌ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى' (يونس: 71-72). و يونس عليه السلام هو نبي الله الذي قضى بعض حياته في بطن الحوت.

in_urdu.name: یونس
in_urdu.meaning: نام مشتق از کلمہ یونس، اشارہ بہ صبر و توکل
in_urdu.long_meaning: یونس ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے: صبر، اللہ پر توکل، حوت (سمندر کا جانور)। یہ نام قرآن کریم سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں یہ ذکر ہے کہ حضرت یونس علیہ السلام نے اپنے قوم پر زور دیا کہ وہ صرف اللہ کی عبادت کریں اور اس کے ساتھ کسی کو شریک نہ بنائیں۔

in_hindi.name: यूनुस
in_hindi.meaning: नाम यونس से लिया गया है, धैर्य और भरोसे का प्रतीक
in_hindi.long_meaning: यूनुस एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है: धैर्य, ईश्वर पर भरोसा, और समुद्र का जीव (ह्वेल)। यह नाम कुरआन से लिया गया है, जहां यह उल्लेख है कि हज़रत यूनुस अलैहिस्सलाम ने अपनी क़ौम पर ज़ोर दिया कि वे केवल अल्लाह की इबादत करें और उसके साथ किसी को साझी न बनाएं।

in_pashto.name: يونس
in_pashto.meaning: د يونس څخه اخيستل شوی نوم، د صبر او توکل نښه
in_pashto.long_meaning: يونس يو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي اصلي څخه يی اخيستی دی او معنی يی دي: صبر، پر الله توکل، حوت (سمندر کا ژوندی). دا نوم د قرآن کریم څخه اخيستی دی چیرته چې دا ذکر دی چې حضرت يونس عليه السلام خپل قوم ته ټينګار وکړ چې يوازې د الله تعالی عبادت وکړي او د هغه سره بل څوک شريک نه کړي.

in_english.name: Yunus
in_english.meaning: Derived from Jonah, symbolizing patience and trust in God
in_english.long_meaning: Yunus is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning patience, trust in God, and whale. It is derived from the Quranic story of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), who was swallowed by a whale and then miraculously saved. The name signifies spiritual growth through patience and trust in divine providence. Historically, it holds significance in Islamic tradition as a prophet who preached monotheism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yunus holds significant cultural importance in various Islamic communities around the world. In Arabic, the name Yunus is derived from the Hebrew name "Jonah" who is a major character in the Holy Bible as well as in the Quran. His story of being swallowed by a whale and then being miraculously saved is a well-known tale in Islamic culture. This story serves as a reminder of Allah's immense power, mercy, and the importance of repentance.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Yunus lies in its deeper meaning, "He who saves." This name serves as a constant reminder that only Allah has the power to save and protect us from the trials and tribulations of life. The story of Yunus also teaches us the importance of repentance and seeking Allah's forgiveness. It exemplifies the way Allah remains merciful towards his creation even after they have strayed from the right path. Ultimately, the name Yunus is a beautiful reminder of Allah's limitless mercy and compassion.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Caliph Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz (634-720 CE), Umayyad Caliphate. The name Yunus carried significant weight in that era.

He was also known for his patronage of scholars and his charitable works. The name Yunus is believed to have been given to one of his sons, who is mentioned in historical records.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Yunus, which originated from the Islamic prophet Jonah, has gained modern relevance in various contexts. It is seen as a symbol of globalization due to the widespread recognition and acceptance of the prophet's story across cultures and religions. In the tech industry, Yunus is a popular name for startups and companies, reflecting the entrepreneurial spirit and resilience associated with the biblical character. Additionally, in the fields of education and health, Yunus is a reminder of the importance of spiritual and moral values in personal development and well-being.
